triggers.detailsText: With no resolution to the West Asia crisis, crude oil and polymer prices remained elevated throughout H1FY27, straining the working capital of our customers and leading them to push back machine deliveries. Other Expenses for H1FY27 were 18% higher YoY, including the higher exhibition and trade show costs incurred in Q1, while Employee Benefit Expenses rose 7%.
